caption: The drawing depicts two figures modeled to resemble construction workers engaged in bricklaying. The worker on the left is partially obscured by a red brick wall with patches of gray mortar and is reaching toward the other worker. He wears a light shirt, blue vest, and a brown cap. The worker on the right stands in the foreground and faces the wall, holding a tool with both hands while wearing dark overalls with a red shirt underneath and a green hat with a wide brim and a square object attached to the back. At the worker’s feet is a wooden bucket with metal bands. The brick wall is set on a base composed of gray rectangular blocks, and the entire scene stands on a larger reddish-brown base with a darker brown trim. To the right side of the base, there is a gray rectangular structure with an object resembling a trowel on top. The overall composition is rendered with muted colors, and the objects are arranged to suggest an active construction site. The name “CHRIST MARKREND” is written at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Toy Bank: Masons
